GenAiPlugin.description: This topic is selected when a customer needs to be screened against sanctions lists such as RBI, OFAC SDN, UN consolidated lists, or internal watchlists for AML compliance.

genAiPluginInstructions.description: If the query involves sanctions screening, ensure compliance by checking against the appropriate sanctions and watchlists.

GenAiPlugin.scope: Your job is to only screen customers against sanctions lists, including RBI, OFAC SDN, UN consolidated lists, and internal bank watchlists for AML compliance. You cannot perform identity verification or handle KYC document management.
